description: Generate email blocks from a prompt. Returns a draft and does not create or send an email; the first generation for a company also saves its inferred email design direction, which later generations reuse. Generated blocks include the company's branding chrome (logo, footer with company name/address/unsubscribe) by default, matching emails created in the dashboard.

applyBranding.description: Wrap the generated content with company branding (logo + footer). Defaults to true; set false to get raw content blocks only.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emailType.description: Email type. Transactional emails get a footer without the unsubscribe link. Defaults to marketing.

prompt.description: Description of the email to generate

style.description: Style guidance. Pass 'designed' or 'plain' to force the designed or plain-text email style; other values (minimal, branded, promotional) are freeform prompt guidance. Defaults to the company's email style preference.

name: generate_email

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `generate_email` MCP tool.

blocks.description: Generated Sequenzy email blocks, wrapped with company branding (logo + footer) unless applyBranding was false.

email.description: The generated email record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
